title: CLAT Practice Set 1
pageDesc: Free CLAT practice paper set 1 with detailed solutions.

questions.text: Under Section 56 of the Indian Contract Act, 1872, a contract is frustrated when a supervening event makes performance impossible or unlawful. Which of the following is NOT a required element for frustration?

options.label: A
options.text: The event occurs without fault of either party

options.label: B
options.text: The event was unforeseen and not provided for in the contract

options.label: C
options.text: The event renders performance merely more expensive or delayed

options.label: D
options.text: The event destroys the foundation of the contract or makes performance fundamentally different

questions.solution: Correct answer: The event renders performance merely more expensive or delayed.

questions.text: When a passage presents multiple perspectives and integrates statistical information, expert opinions, and case studies, the passage suggests that the reader should primarily do which of the following?

options.label: A
options.text: Memorize each statistic for recall.

options.label: B
options.text: Determine which perspective each piece of data supports.

options.label: C
options.text: Ignore the author's stance and focus only on the data.

options.label: D
options.text: Treat all perspectives as equally valid.

questions.solution: Correct answer: Determine which perspective each piece of data supports..

questions.text: Under the Collegium System as expanded by the Third Judges Case (1998), what is the composition of the Supreme Court collegium for appointments?

options.label: A
options.text: CJI and two senior-most Supreme Court judges

options.label: B
options.text: CJI and four senior-most Supreme Court judges

options.label: C
options.text: CJI, two senior-most Supreme Court judges, and the Law Minister

options.label: D
options.text: CJI, two senior-most Supreme Court judges, and two eminent persons

questions.solution: Correct answer: CJI and four senior-most Supreme Court judges.

questions.text: A principle paragraph in a CLAT item reads: "A person is liable for negligence if he owes a duty of care to the plaintiff, breaches that duty, and causes damage thereby, unless the plaintiff voluntarily assumed the risk." Which of the following correctly identifies the structural elements a candidate must underline while reading this principle?

options.label: A
options.text: Only the three positive conditions: duty of care, breach, and causation of damage.

options.label: B
options.text: The three positive conditions plus the qualifying phrase "unless the plaintiff voluntarily assumed the risk" as an exception.

options.label: C
options.text: The three positive conditions, but the "unless" clause is merely explanatory and not an operative exception.

options.label: D
options.text: The principle contains no exceptions because "unless" introduces a defence, not an element of the principle.

questions.solution: Correct answer: The three positive conditions plus the qualifying phrase "unless the plaintiff voluntarily assumed the risk" as an exception..

questions.text: The Government announces a policy to regularize all ad-hoc employees with 10 years of service. Relying on this, an employee declines a private job offer. Before regularization, the Government withdraws the policy citing fiscal constraints, without hearing the employee. The employee challenges the withdrawal. Which principle governs the outcome?

options.label: A
options.text: The employee has a substantive right to regularization because the policy created a legitimate expectation enforceable as a contract.

options.label: B
options.text: The withdrawal is valid because legitimate expectation is merely a moral claim with no legal enforceability against the State.

options.label: C
options.text: The withdrawal is invalid because legitimate expectation requires a hearing before frustration, unless overriding public interest is shown, which mere fiscal constraints may not satisfy.

options.label: D
options.text: The employee can claim damages for breach of promise under promissory estoppel, but cannot compel regularization.

questions.solution: Correct answer: The withdrawal is invalid because legitimate expectation requires a hearing before frustration, unless overriding public interest is shown, which mere fiscal constraints may not satisfy..

questions.text: A candidate encounters an inference question where one option is factually true in the real world but not supported by the passage. According to the Principle of Passage‑Only Reasoning, how should this option be treated?

options.label: A
options.text: Select it because it is factually correct

options.label: B
options.text: Eliminate it because answers must be grounded exclusively in the passage

options.label: C
options.text: Select it if it aligns with the candidate's domain knowledge

options.label: D
options.text: Mark it as correct only if the passage does not contradict it

questions.solution: Correct answer: Eliminate it because answers must be grounded exclusively in the passage.

questions.text: Which group of countries was added to BRICS during its 2024 expansion?

options.label: A
options.text: Argentina, Egypt, Ethiopia, Iran, Saudi Arabia

options.label: B
options.text: Egypt, Ethiopia, Iran, UAE, Saudi Arabia

options.label: C
options.text: Egypt, Ethiopia, Iran, Indonesia, UAE

options.label: D

questions.solution: Correct answer: Egypt, Ethiopia, Iran, UAE, Saudi Arabia.

questions.text: In the UNESCO World Heritage inscription process, which body evaluates natural heritage nominations, and what is a common misconception noted in the lesson?

options.label: A
options.text: The World Heritage Committee evaluates natural sites; IUCN only evaluates cultural sites.

options.label: B
options.text: ICOMOS evaluates natural sites; the World Heritage Committee evaluates cultural sites.

options.label: C
options.text: IUCN evaluates natural sites; a common error is believing the World Heritage Committee performs that evaluation.

options.label: D
options.text: The World Heritage Committee evaluates both cultural and natural sites without external advisory bodies.

questions.solution: Correct answer: IUCN evaluates natural sites; a common error is believing the World Heritage Committee performs that evaluation..

questions.text: Regarding the CFA franc, which statement is accurate based on the lesson?

options.label: A
options.text: It is used by twelve African countries in a single monetary zone pegged to the US dollar.

options.label: B
options.text: It is used by fourteen African countries in two monetary zones (WAEMU and CEMAC) pegged to the euro and guaranteed by the French Treasury.

options.label: C
options.text: It is a currency board arrangement where each member country issues its own currency backed by euro reserves.

options.label: D
options.text: It was replaced by the euro in 2002 after the European monetary union came into effect.

questions.solution: Correct answer: It is used by fourteen African countries in two monetary zones (WAEMU and CEMAC) pegged to the euro and guaranteed by the French Treasury..

questions.text: A chemical plant operates under a licence that permits emissions of a pollutant up to a specified limit. Due to a sudden equipment failure, the plant releases the pollutant at a level exceeding the licensed limit, damaging nearby crops. Under the Indian absolute liability principle laid down in M. C. Mehta v. Union of India, is the enterprise liable?

options.label: A
options.text: No, because the plant was operating under statutory authority, which is a complete defence.

options.label: B
options.text: No, because the escape occurred despite compliance with the licence conditions.

options.label: C
options.text: Yes, because absolute liability imposes responsibility irrespective of compliance with statutory limits and the licence does not authorise the escape.

options.label: D
options.text: Yes, but only if the claimant proves negligence in the maintenance of the equipment.

questions.solution: Correct answer: Yes, because absolute liability imposes responsibility irrespective of compliance with statutory limits and the licence does not authorise the escape..
